description: fish: Tide prompt in Dracula colors, Homebrew on PATH, eza aliases, multiplexer shortcuts

hint.linux: fish 4.0 or newer: sudo add-apt-repository ppa:fish-shell/release-4 && sudo apt install fish, or your distribution's fish 4 package

hint.macos: brew install tmux (the multiplexer shortcuts, such as dev and a, act on it)
hint.linux: sudo apt install tmux (the multiplexer shortcuts, such as dev and a, act on it)

hint.macos: brew install eza (ls, ll, ld, lf, lh and lt list with eza)
hint.linux: sudo apt install eza (ls, ll, ld, lf, lh and lt list with eza)

hint.macos: brew install zoxide (z jumps to a frequently used folder)
hint.linux: sudo apt install zoxide (z jumps to a frequently used folder)
sudo apt install direnv (loads a project's .envrc)
